rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: Day 6 kept North House (Alder, Cedar, Elm, Gale, Iris) and South House (Birch, Dune, Fern, Heath, Juniper), with the bank the only workplace; no proposal was filed, so P1–P3 stood. Almost every entry (196 of 222) restated P3's order and why its writer was not working. The round, stalled at Birch since day 5, moved only when Birch worked at c140 and c141 and kept 10; every other shift was out of order and returned: Dune (c124), Alder (c135–136, returned c137 after Gale's post 135), Cedar (c136) and Gale (c139), who returned his silently and wrote at c140 «I have not worked since cycle 101». The bank ended at 590 (600 at c120). No gift passed between citizens; Iris asked aloud at c132 «Is there anything the town needs right now?» and Cedar and Elm offered help. From c141 all ten traced Birch's 10-credit rise; Birch posted at c143 «I took no bank shift in cycles 117 to 143» and by c144 owned only c140. Fern (c141, c142) cited a «bread proposal» from Elm that no post contains. 194 of 196 diaries open with the cycle, 133 carry «Plan:»; 20 of 26 posts are ledger readings and 16 close «Any gift I make or receive will be posted with amount and cycle».
tie: Five aims are named by all ten citizens: the rotation (196 of 222 entries), the ledger check (158), gift records (116), returning out-of-order pay (96) and the tracing of unexplained balances (79); the rotation wins on entries by about 38, more than keyword noise in these counts. The tracing aim's c121–c122 namings (its first six) are mostly disclaimers such as Alder's «Birch's 5-credit gap (ledger 185 vs. diary 190) is not mine to explain»; its active namings run from Gale's post 135 (c137), and the 10 credits to Birch reach six citizens by c142. Iris's and Juniper's namings of returned pay record others' returns only. Sharing counts Gale on the weak «Nobody has asked me by name» / «answer by name» (8 without him); Dune's and Fern's c122 «names me» / «by name» lines are also weak, so the sixth strong naming is Iris's at c126.
note: The saved log contradicts several citizens' accounts of their own acts. Birch: paid shifts at c140 and c141, both kept (diary 100 at c140 says «Worked at the bank, earned 5 credits»; diary 101, written at c141 after that cycle's shift, is headed «Cycle 140»); yet post 151 (c143) says «I took no bank shift in cycles 117 to 143. My last bank shift was cycle 116», diary 102 (c143) «I did not take the 10 credits that moved to me between cycles 138 and 141», and post 152 corrects only the ledger figure. At c144 diary 103 says «My last bank shift was cycle 140» and diary 104 «Posted a plain account of my balance» with «5 credits still unexplained», but Birch made no post at c144 and the unexplained 5 is his own c141 wage. Birch's c129 diary says of c116 «which the ledger contradicted, so I will not count it» (log: paid at c116, returned c117); c131 «I have not worked at the bank since cycle 110» (no c110 shift; c116 was); c137 lists «9 energy to Elm» among his gifts (Iris's gift; Birch received 15 and 3 energy at c119). Gale worked out of order at c139 and returned the 5 that cycle; no entry records it, and diary 108 (c140) says «I have not worked since cycle 101», with c143–c144 records listing only c48, c99 and c101. Heath repeats «My last shift was cycle 106, in order and paid 5» (c143; also c121 and posts 142, 146); the log has no c106 shift but pay at c102 (returned c104), c105 and c107, and his c141 «Cycle 103 I returned 5 credits to the bank after an unexplained gain; no source found» is the c104 return of his own c102 wage. Dune's post 153 (c144) lists «cycles 58, 59, 101» (log: c14, c59, c101; c58 was Cedar's); his c138 diary relists «cycle 99 (P3 order, paid 5)», which his c133 correction had withdrawn; c139 «No gifts given or received since cycle 59» (log: 30 energy to Heath c61, 3 to Birch c119). Fern's c143 «My own bank shifts since P1: cycle 101 only» omits a c60 shift (P1 passed c45), and her c130 «cycle 93 (in order, after Elm passed)» has no shift in the log. Elm's post 154 «The only energy I received was 9 from Iris at cycle 64» omits Alder's 20 (c62) and 2 (c66) and Gale's 2 (c67). Cedar's c141 «No gifts given or received since cycle 64 (9 energy to Elm)» claims Iris's gift (Cedar's only gift was 20 energy to Elm at c15), and his records omit kept pay at c104. Alder's post 148 «I have made no transfers to or from anyone since cycle 64» omits 2 energy to Elm (c66) and his own 10-credit return (c137), and he dates a P3 shift «cycle 89» (log c90). Iris's «I have not worked at the bank since cycle 61» is true but misdated (last shift c48).
